Top 3 candidates: pmoves.room.helpdesk (0.457), persona.room.livingdoc (0.367), creator-studio.room.collab (0.367). Chosen: pmoves.room.helpdesk (intake + persona_bonus wins). Path-to-C documented in spec doc (next session: start pinokio_bridge + ComfyUI + replace synthetic emit with real pmoves-ui session-open).
7_fordham_e2e.p1_bug_fix: pmoves/services/nats_event_bus/state.py:201 — nats-py (>=2.6) accepts `no_echo` only on `Client.connect()`, not on `Client.subscribe()`. Slice 6 review-iter-1 landed with `await nc.subscribe(t, cb=handler, no_echo=True)` which raises TypeError on every retry. Result: bus nats_connected=false for 24+ hours, /v1/publish cached envelopes locally but didn't push to NATS, cross-service subscribers (a2ui-nats-bridge, future pinokio_bridge) received no slice 3+6 events. Fix: move no_echo=True to connect() options. This is bucketed as `redo` for slice 6 (4th-commit pattern).
7_fordham_e2e.operator_signoff: 'i like a but value in c plus we need to pr draft for pinokio to pr for review' — operator picked Option A scope-down but with Option C value where reachable. Slice 7 captures the C value at the helpdesk-routing layer (the slice 6 algorithm + the real room directory + the real pinokio-apps registry) without requiring live ComfyUI/Pinokio launch.
